about: BN4's AreaGrab (its chip 117) against BN6's AreaGrab (163), a chip both games name and a run plays as BN6's, by the comparator's MegaMan mode (docs/multirom/bn4-chips.md, unit 3): the pairing by name asked of the differential.
subject: megaman

verdict.why: Through t33 the two differ only where legit.json's bn4 section explains (the chip's id in MegaMan's AttackVars and the grab's object, the object's spawn's r3, BN6's support attack ending a frame after its routine). At t34 MegaMan's own state is a frame apart (his +0x0B 4 and +0x20 9 in BN4's, a frame into the state BN6's enters then: BN6's support run holds him a frame longer, 0x080ED12A), and the grab's sounds (BN4's 0x93 and 0x94, BN6's 0xA1, 0xA2 and 0x173) and its panels' marks (+3, +4, +7) are not yet read in both games' code. Open work of unit 3: MegaMan's clock after a support attack, the chips' sounds, the panels' marks.
